canonical_key.description: the canonical Level 1 work-activity slug (e.g. a work-type slug), the join key every consumer resolves against

job_task_no.description: one BC `Job_Task_No` that maps to this slug — a **sample**, because the normalizer keeps only the first `task_no` seen per slug

label.description: human-readable work-activity name (the display name on the spine)

legal_entity_id.description: owning legal entity where the source is multi-company (BC company context)

source_external_id.description: the raw record identity in the producing system (today the slug itself)

work_activity_id.description: Demiton canonical `WORK_ACTIVITY` spine node this fact is about
